title: Best Google Ads Keywords for Roofers (+ Negatives to Block)

facts.fact: The author states high-intent roofing keywords have a cost per click of $25-$45.
The author states high-intent roofing keywords have a conversion rate of 8-15%.
The author states mid-intent roofing keywords have a cost per click of $15-$30.
The author states mid-intent roofing keywords have a conversion rate of 5-10%.
The author states low-intent (informational) roofing keywords have a cost per click of $8-$18.
The author states low-intent (informational) roofing keywords have a conversion rate of 2-5%.
The author recommends that a roofing company with a monthly budget of $3,000 or less put 80-90% of its spend on high-intent keywords.
facts.quote: If you have a limited budget ($3,000/month or less): Focus 80-90% on high-intent keywords.

facts.fact: The author recommends a moderate budget of $5,000-$8,000 per month be split 70% high-intent, 20% mid-intent, and 10% informational keywords.
facts.quote: If you have a moderate budget ($5,000-$8,000/month): 70% high-intent, 20% mid-intent, 10% informational.

facts.fact: The author recommends a large budget of $10,000+ per month be split 60% high-intent, 30% mid-intent, and 10% informational keywords.
facts.quote: If you have a large budget ($10,000+/month): 60% high-intent, 30% mid-intent, 10% informational.

facts.fact: The author states emergency roof repair keywords have a conversion rate of 10-15%.
The author states emergency roofing leads have a close rate of 60-80% if the company responds fast.
facts.quote: Close rate: 60-80% if you respond fast

facts.fact: The author states roof replacement keywords have a cost per click of $18-$35.
The author states roof replacement keywords have a conversion rate of 6-10%.
The author states the average roof replacement job is worth $10,000-$20,000.
The article was published on November 21, 2025 and last updated on June 14, 2026.
